name: fetch_grids
description: Fetches all gridlines in the project, including their unique IDs, labels, endpoints, and curvature details.

grid_id.description: The UniqueId of the target grid.

name: create_grid
description: Creates a new linear gridline in the project.

name: create_level
description: Creates a new horizontal datum level with options to configure custom visual extents.

maximize_extents.description: Option to maximize the default 3D extents. Defaults to True.

max_y.description: Optional maximum Y visual boundary in feet.

reference_level_id.description: Optional UniqueId of an existing level to copy extents from across views.

min_x.description: Optional minimum X visual boundary in feet.

max_x.description: Optional maximum X visual boundary in feet.

min_y.description: Optional minimum Y visual boundary in feet.

name: modify_level
description: Modifies height elevation, renames, or updates the 3D/2D extents of an existing level.

max_x.description: Optional new maximum X boundary in feet.

reference_level_id.description: Optional UniqueId of an existing level to copy extents from.

level_id.description: The UniqueId of the target level.

min_y.description: Optional new minimum Y boundary in feet.

min_x.description: Optional new minimum X boundary in feet.

max_y.description: Optional new maximum Y boundary in feet.

name.description: Optional new name for the level.

elevation.description: Optional new elevation height in feet.

name: delete_level
description: Deletes an existing level. Deletes all associated plan views automatically.

level_id.description: The UniqueId of the target level.

name: fetch_levels
description: Fetches all levels in the project, including their absolute 3D model boundary extents.

name: modify_grid
description: Modifies coordinates or renames an existing gridline.

name.description: Optional new name for the grid.

grid_id.description: The UniqueId of the grid to edit.
